unit: USD per metric ton CO₂, 2020 dollars
note: The social cost of carbon is the dollar damage one extra tonne of CO₂ does, worldwide, over its lifetime in the atmosphere. The EPA's 2023 report publishes three figures — the choice among them is mostly a discount rate, i.e. how much a future harm is worth today. Shown as published values, not as an endorsement of any one rate.
